Id: mii-exa-molgen-protocol-agilent-sureselect
Title: Agilent SureSelect Human All Exon V7 Kit Protocol
Type:

system: http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/plan-definition-type

code: protocol

display: Protocol

Description:

Target enrichment protocol for whole exome sequencing covering 35.8 Mb of the human exome
Actions:
DNA Fragmentation: Fragment genomic DNA to 150-200bp using Covaris
Library Preparation: End repair, A-tailing, adapter ligation
Hybridization: Hybridize with SureSelect baits for 24 hours at 65°C
Capture: Streptavidin bead capture and washing
Amplification: PCR amplification of captured library
